hero.heading: About
bio.p1: 10+ years designing digital products in regulated environments, including Germany's first BITV-certified government app used by over 1 million people.
bio.p2: Master's in Design for Responsible AI. Building the Trust by Design framework at the intersection of accessibility, AI governance, and human-centred design.
bio.p3: I work with public-sector and regulated-industry teams to find where their AI systems exclude people -- and fix it before it becomes a legal or reputational problem.
bio.location: Anchored in Berlin. Working across the EU.
approach.heading: How I work
approach.body: I don't write 80-page policy documents. I build practical decision tools for the people who actually make daily choices about AI. I test with the users most likely to be excluded. And I translate what your system does into language that builds trust rather than confusion.
cta.heading: Want to work together?
cta.body: A 20-minute conversation costs nothing and usually answers the question.
